headline: Eldorado Gold Activates First Filter Presses at Skouries Mine
summary: Eldorado Gold announced the activation of the first filter presses at its Skouries mine development project.
why: Eldorado Gold Corporation is an international mining company engaged in the exploration and production of gold and base metals.

impacts.name: Eldorado Gold
impacts.why: Commissioning equipment at the Skouries project advances construction and de-risks the mine's operational timeline.
